function.description: Use when you need to inspect a single CSV file: returns columns, approximate dtypes, row_count, head (first 20 data rows), and tail (last 5 data rows that are not already in head). This is a SAMPLE preview, not full data access. For filtering, aggregation, joins, or any full-file scan, use execute_python instead — the head/tail will miss rows in between.
function.name: read_csv

parameters.description:
`read_csv` 入参：仅 path，**刻意没有** max_rows / head / tail 旋钮。

设计契约：read_csv 是 inspect-style 工具——返回固定的 schema + head(20) + tail(5)；
模型无法通过加大窗口绕过样本语义。需要全量过滤/聚合时唯一出口是 execute_python。
任何 max_rows/limit/offset 字段都会因 `extra="forbid"` 显式报错，把这个边界打到
Pydantic 校验层，让模型立刻拿到可操作的反馈。

path.description: Relative path to a CSV file. Examples: 'csv/member.csv', 'data/train.csv'. Paths are relative to the task context directory; DO NOT prepend 'context/'. For example use 'knowledge.md' or 'csv/foo.csv', not 'context/knowledge.md'.
